senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; זָמַם III) [filth (cmp. זוֹהֲמָא),] obscenity, libidiousness, carnality.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 152a">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>שטוף בזי׳</he> excessive in carnal gratification.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:8">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>אלהיהם של אלו שונא ז׳ הוא</he> their (the Israelites’) God hates libidiousness.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 16b:19">B. Kam. 16ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>זנים</he>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 16:14">II Chr. XVI, 14</cite>) <he>כל המריח … לידי ז׳</he> whoever smells them becomes lusty.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:7">Ab. II, 7</cite> <he>מרבה זמה</he> increases unchastity; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17b:3">Ab. Zar. 17ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>מזמה</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 2:11">Prov. II, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00362">next w.</cite>) <he>מדבר זי׳ וכ׳</he> she (the Torah) will guard thee from improper conduct.

senses.gloss: (homilet.; cmp. זָמַם I, דּוּמָה, דְּמַאי &c.) suspicion, parental uncertainty. Sifra K’dosh., Par. 3, ch. VII ממלא … ממזרים שנ׳ ז׳ זֹה מ̇ה ה̇וא he fills the world with bastards, as it says (Lev. XIX, 29) the land will be full of zimmah, ‘what is this person?’; Yeb. 37ᵇ הכי קאמר זו מה היא R. El. b. Jacob means by zimmah doubts as to paternity.
